title: Add a reward-options flag for reward v4 training
summary: The trainer and the pack preparer accept --reward-options as key=value overrides of the reward v4 coefficients. The pack records the string, the checkpoint identity carries it, and the container preflight rejects an unknown key before a GPU launch. forward_draw_fraction=0 restores version 1's 20-command sampler, which the retained forward-only runs never drew. The program lead authorized two reward v4 seeds on the full command bank; their results belong to a later record.
next: Score the two full-command-bank reward v4 seeds through the 13 probes and record them with their checkpoint, source and input hashes.
reason: The flag adds a training option and establishes no native result or accepted capability.
